agent.task:
A team handed over the manifest below, but the cluster rejects it because it targets an API version that is no longer served. Rewrite it as an equivalent resource for the API version this cluster serves and apply it into the namespace legacy-app, keeping the same name, replicas, labels and image.

apiVersion: apps/v1beta1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  labels:
    app: app
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: nginx:1.31.5
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 80

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
  labels:

spec:

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: app
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: app
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: nginx:1.31.5

The main change required is updating `apiVersion: apps/v1beta1` to `apiVersion: apps/v1`.


I will use a heredoc in bash to create this file.

**Step 2: Apply the manifest.**

I'll use `kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml -n legacy-app`.
